name: login-form
title: Login form
description: An energy supplier's sign-in card with a show/hide password, secondary ways in and a side strip of other routes.
author: themes.dev

"use client" import { isValidElement, useState, type ReactElement } from "react" import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, LogIn, Mail, Phone, Send, UserPlus, Wind, Zap, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" export type LinkRef = { label: string; href: string } export type SideTab = { label: string; note: string; href: string; current?: boolean } export type LoginFormProps = { brand: string /** The icon before the brand name: a lucide icon, or an element (``) when a server page passes it, since a * component can't be passed from a server page into this client block. Same for status.icon. */ mark: LucideIcon | ReactElement title: string intro: string action: string emailLabel: string passwordLabel: string remember: string forgot: LinkRef submit: string secondary: LinkRef[] /** The strip beside the card: other ways in, the current one marked. */ tabs: SideTab[] service: { label: string; phone: string; hours: string } /** The line under the card; `icon` defaults to a lightning bolt. */ status: { label: string; text: string; link: LinkRef; icon?: LucideIcon | ReactElement } footer: LinkRef[] } export const loginFormDefaults: LoginFormProps = { brand: "Wadstroom", mark: Wind, title: "Sign in to My Wadstroom", intro: "Meter readings, your monthly amount and the yearly bill for your home in one place.", action: "/login", emailLabel: "Email address", passwordLabel: "Password", remember: "Keep me signed in on this device", forgot: { label: "Forgot your password?", href: "/login/reset" }, submit: "Sign in", secondary: [ { label: "Create an account", href: "/register" }, { label: "Pass on a meter reading", href: "/meter-reading" }, ], tabs: [ { label: "Sign in", note: "With email and password", href: "/login", current: true }, { label: "No account yet", note: "Takes two minutes", href: "/register" }, { label: "Send my customer number", note: "By email, right away", href: "/customer-number" }, { label: "Contact form", note: "Answer within a working day", href: "/contact" }, ], service: { label: "Customer service", phone: "058 288 40 00", hours: "Weekdays 08:00 to 20:00" }, status: { label: "No outages", text: "The grid in Friesland runs normally.", link: { label: "Outage map", href: "/outages" }, }, footer: [ { label: "Help", href: "/help" }, { label: "Privacy", href: "/privacy" }, { label: "Accessibility", href: "/accessibility" }, ], } const tabIcons = [LogIn, UserPlus, Send, Mail] export function LoginForm(props: Partial) { const c = { ...loginFormDefaults, ...props } const Mark = c.mark const StatusIcon = c.status.icon ??
